summary: Six even-index theorems use uncommented `change` to unfold `evenIndex` to the private `compressionIndex`, and other uncommented `change` steps rely on definitional unfolding. Repeated reasoning (CompleteSpace instances, the even `zeroRep` side proofs, block-operator compactness factorizations, scalar sqrt arithmetic) is copied instead of factored into lemmas.
